responsibility: Implements dead and redundant store elimination for GIMPLE SSA by walking memory-def chains in reverse program order. It models stores and certain builtin/internal memory operations as ao_ref accesses, classifies stores as live, partially dead, or dead, trims partially dead stores, removes redundant call or assignment stores when safe, handles EH and abnormal-edge cleanup, and optionally uses data-reference analysis for more expensive loop-aware reasoning.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation and pass-definition file for dead and redundant store elimination, with the reverse walk over memory defs, ao_ref construction, partial-store trimming, call handling, and CFG/EH cleanup. The companion gcc/tree-ssa-dse.h only declares support types and helper routines used by DSE and related optimizers.
